method: Two distinct roster accounts eligible under stored state and ramp checks, using saved sessions mounted at /app/sessions and assigned proxies. Existing-session validation followed by the actual client media download and normalization. No fresh login, no auth export, no Telegram sends, no production session/state writes. Public comparison used identical links and normalization preset.
limitations: Times end at media preparation, not Telegram delivery.
Different source resolutions: this is not an equal-quality comparison.
Two successful saved-session samples do not prove all34sessions healthy or recover the6prewarm failures.
No paired3.0.14canary; cannot attribute speed improvements to the dependency upgrade.
Fresh-login CAA verification branch was not exercised.
routing_recommendation: For latency-focused mode, try one eligible saved-session account with a bounded attempt before public yt-dlp. Preserve account proxy/ramp/cooldown policy and public fallback. Make720p/full-resolution tradeoff explicit. Routing order remains unchanged pending this policy decision.
